channel.title: International: Top News And Analysis
channel.description: CNBC International is the world leader for news on business, technology, China, trade, oil prices, the Middle East and markets.

item.title: The AI kill switch, explained: 'It's not too little, but it's probably too late'
item.description: As runaway AI fears reach a crescendo, policymakers and tech leaders are weighing the effectiveness of a magic AI stop button known as a kill switch.

item.title: Flames reported near Saudi capital airport as Pakistan presses Iran over energy supplies
item.description: Smoke and flames were seen near Riyadh’s main airport after Saudi civil-defense alerts, while Pakistan urged Iran to protect energy supplies and shipping.

item.title: A new arms race is unfolding on the ocean floor
item.description: Countries and companies are investing in technologies for underwater use amid concerns about the vulnerability of critical infrastructure on the ocean floor.

item.title: Trump says U.S. to build a 'large Military presence' in Greenland as part of a security deal with it and Denmark
item.description: Greenland has maintained it is not for sale, and the European Union earlier this year united to rebuke Trump over his push to acquire the island.

item.title: MS NOW, CNN and Politico journalists blocked from White House after Trump ban
item.description: Journalists from MS NOW, CNN and Politico were denied access to the White House, one day after Trump banned three media outlets over their coverage of him.

item.title: Putin braces for election stress test as Russians ‘feel the pain’ of struggling economy
item.description: Russia’s upcoming election is expected to cement United Russia’s dominance, but voter turnout and its margin of victory could offer clues to public discontent.

item.title: Pokémon card curbs send shares of Japanese online marketplace Mercari on a bumpy ride
item.description: Mercari shares are clawing back losses after Pokémon card listing restrictions triggered a selloff earlier this week.

item.title: Consumer sentiment is in the dumps despite a solid economy. Goldman Sachs blames 'lower happiness'
item.description: Goldman economist Joseph Briggs said broader pessimism in society may be contributing to struggling consumer sentiment even as the economy chugs along.

item.title: She pays $96 a month to live in Yellowstone National Park: 'Being here has changed my life'
item.description: Zoe De La Paz quit her corporate job in Chicago and in June moved to Yellowstone to work as a seamstress.

item.title: JPMorgan, Citigroup CEOs attending Trump's state dinner for China's Xi: Sources
item.description: Dimon and Fraser join OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, Nvidia chief Jensen Huang and others who are reportedly planning to attend the Trump-Xi state dinner.

item.title: Elon Musk talks up AI safety while fighting regulation in wild week of strange alliances
item.description: In the past week, Musk has agreed with the CEOs of Anthropic and OpenAI, while getting contradicted by President Trump and Nvidia's Jensen Huang.

item.title: Auto industry urges Trump to bar Chinese automakers in U.S. ahead of Xi visit
item.description: Leaders of six major auto trade groups joined to sign a letter to the president.

item.title: Anthropic and OpenAI hunt for smaller data center deals, sources tell CNBC, in race to deploy AI capacity
item.description: Anthropic and OpenAI have announced a flurry of AI infrastructure deals over the past year as demand booms.

item.title: Anthropic selects Accenture as first embedded evaluator to help implement Amodei's slowdown proposal
item.description: Anthropic and OpenAI have been under intense scrutiny after researchers warned about the potential for AI to cause catastrophic harm to humanity.

item.title: AI cloud provider Nscale files to go public
item.description: Nscale is the latest artificial intelligence neocloud to turn to public markets.

item.title: Three words from Kevin Warsh have Wall Street wondering how far the Fed will go with rate hikes
item.description: The chairman both explained this week's decision to raise interest rates, and raised vexing questions about what comes next

item.title: Nike parts ways with Kylian Mbappé; soccer superstar signs with On
item.description: Mbappe had been signed with Nike for roughly two decades, and his agreement with On is the first it has made with a soccer player.

item.title: Putin targets Nestle's Russian business as Kremlin tightens grip on Western assets
item.description: Nestlé is assessing its options after Russia placed the Swiss food giant’s local assets under temporary external administration.

item.title: Disney names CTO for the first time as media giant expands tech push
item.description: Disney has hired a chief technology officer, a newly minted role for the company, as it looks to further its embrace of tech under CEO Josh D'Amaro.

item.title: Warren Buffett steps down as chairman of Berkshire Hathaway: 'Father Time always wins'
item.description: Buffett's son Howard will replace him as chairman, as dictated by a long-standing succession plan, Berkshire said.

item.title: Fed staff should have known Silicon Valley Bank was vulnerable, new report finds
item.description: Fed Vice Chair for Supervision Michelle Bowman said a new report indicates the central bank's staff missed signs ahead of Silicon Valley Bank's 2023 failure.

item.title: California Gov. Newsom issues executive order to rein in AI 'before it's too late'
item.description: California Gov. Gavin Newsom and other 2028 Democratic presidential hopefuls have called for a more aggressive approach to addressing AI fears.

item.title: Trump administration advances $24.3 billion fighter jet deal to Saudi Arabia as Houthis escalate attacks
item.description: The deal comes as Iran-backed Houthis escalate attacks on Saudi Arabia and seek control of the strategically important Bab el-Mandeb Strait.

item.title: StubHub shares tick higher for third day in a row after Citi upgrade
item.description: Analyst Jason Bazinet raised his rating to buy from neutral.

item.title: Ticket prices rise for Macklemore solo concert after Ed Sheeran tour removal
item.description: Ticket prices are rising for Macklemore's upcoming solo concert after the rapper was removed from Ed Sheeran's tour for making pro-Palestine comments.

item.title: Why Japan’s markets flipped the usual script after central bank rate hike
item.description: The yen weakened past 157 against the dollar, the yield on the 10-year Japanese Government Bond slipped, while the Nikkei 225 gained 1.5%.

item.title: An intense boardroom battle is brewing at India's giant Tata Group
item.description: In 10 years, India's leading multinational conglomerate, the Tata Group, is facing a new power struggle between the chairman of Tata Sons and Tata Trusts.

item.title: AirAsia's Fernandes refutes financial concerns, points to new growth plans
item.description: AirAsia's Tony Fernandes pushed back against a report raising concerns over the airline’s financial health, while signaling plans to resume growth.

item.title: Bank of Japan raises interest rates to 31-year high, flags concerns over inflation
item.description: The decision was split 7-2, with board members Toichiro Asada and Ayano Sato dissenting from the hike.

item.title: Trump gains a tariff weapon against China and India. Will he use it?
item.description: U.S. House has paved the way for a legislation that will allow Trump to impose up to 100% tariffs on countries buying Russian oil, giving him leverage against India and China.
